verdict.rationale: A secure client portal or extranet is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions a client extranet for matters, documents or status. Founders Workbench offers free public information, calculators and a formation-document generator (Document Driver®), which is an adjacent tool, not a secure portal for client matters.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
